// divguard:path internal/codingagent/session_manager.go

package codingagent

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
)

type entry struct{ Type string }

// parse fails the stream on the first bad chunk.
func parse(lines [][]byte) ([]entry, error) {
	var out []entry
	for _, line := range lines {
		var e entry
		if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &e); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse chunk: %w", err)
		}
		out = append(out, e)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// reply reports each bad command to the client and keeps serving.
func reply(cmds [][]byte, send func(string)) {
	for _, raw := range cmds {
		var e entry
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &e); err != nil {
			send(err.Error())
			continue
		}
		send(e.Type)
	}
}

// load skips malformed lines exactly as upstream session loading does.
func load(lines [][]byte) []entry {
	var out []entry
	for _, line := range lines {
		var e entry
		// upstream: coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts:parseSessionEntries
		if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &e); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, e)
	}
	return out
}

// decodeOnce is outside any loop.
func decodeOnce(raw []byte) entry {
	var e entry
	_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &e)
	return e
}
